## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do, and why? Keep it brief - the diff shows the what. -->

## Type of Change

<!-- Check all that apply -->
- [ ] New contest definition (`contests/*.json`)
- [ ] Contest engine change (scoring, multipliers, JSON schema)
- [ ] UI / widget change
- [ ] Rig control / CW decoder / audio
- [ ] File format (CLX / ADIF / Cabrillo / CSV)
- [ ] Build / CI / packaging
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation only

## Testing

<!-- Both suites must pass. Paste the relevant output or confirm they're green. -->
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make test-logs-headless` passes
- [ ] Manually exercised the change in a running `./clx` session
- [ ] If new contest: added an entry to `test_logs/automated_tests.json`

**Platforms tested:**
- [ ] Linux
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Windows (or relying on CI)

## Changelog

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the current version
- [ ] Entry placed in the correct section (Contest Updates / Contest Engine Changes / Other Changes and Bugfixes)
- [ ] Entry is worded as a user-facing release note (not a commit message)

## Notes for Reviewers

<!-- Anything reviewers should pay extra attention to: tricky logic, cross-platform concerns, follow-ups deferred to another PR, screenshots for UI changes, etc. -->
